readiness.scope: pre-access numerical correctness gate before comparator quality or serving measurements

motivation: Optimized serving baselines can silently diverge from trusted native or Hugging Face execution; compare exact scored token log probabilities before accepting their downstream measurements.
risk_context: Pre-access response to the failure class highlighted by Magic's reported vLLM/SGLang baseline issues; the report itself is not Speck qualification evidence.
required_identity: model ID, immutable revision, and artifact SHA-256
tokenizer ID, immutable revision, and artifact SHA-256
canonical payload and SHA-256 for every case
ordered case IDs, token positions, and token IDs

external_evaluation_binding.use: identity and evidence precedent only; this plan does not alter or qualify any external suite

evaluation_server_boundary.decision: do not widen the parser-independent endpoint; collect records separately through trusted backend-native adapters

promotion_rule: none; thresholds are provisional diagnostics until exact model, hardware, backend revisions, dtype policy, payload set, and independent review are frozen before access
limitations: No vLLM or SGLang package is installed or exercised by this plan.
Synthetic fixtures do not estimate real backend error or select final thresholds.
A declared trusted reference is not authenticated by the comparator.
Passing scored-token log probabilities does not qualify generation, cache behavior, throughput, memory, quality, or an external suite.
